description: This file contains C source code for generating JSON output related to the 'write out' feature of curl, specifically for JSON formatting and header output. It defines functions for quoting strings in JSON, outputting JSON data for curl variables, and serializing HTTP headers to JSON.

methods.name: int jsonquoted(const char * in,size_t len,struct curlx_dynbuf * out,bool lowercase)
methods.description: Converts a string into a JSON-quoted string, handling special characters and escaping as needed.

methods.name: void jsonWriteString(FILE * stream,const char * in,bool lowercase)
methods.description: Outputs a string as a JSON string, including quotes, to a given stream.

methods.name: void ourWriteOutJSON(FILE * stream,const struct writeoutvar mappings[],struct per_transfer * per,CURLcode per_result)
methods.description: Serializes curl variables into JSON format and writes to the provided stream.

methods.name: void headerJSON(FILE * stream,struct per_transfer * per)
methods.description: Serializes HTTP headers from a curl transfer into JSON format and writes to the provided stream.
